name: REST Assured
summary: A Java DSL for testing REST services with given-when-then syntax, JSON and XML path assertions and schema validation.
strengths: Readable given-when-then DSL that fits JUnit or TestNG.
JSON Schema validation and rich path assertions.
Mature and widely known in Java teams.
tradeoffs: No built-in mocking or contract features; pair it with WireMock or Pact.
